name: steam
description: Steam in-game purchases (Steam Inventory Service; DLC as non-consumables) for Windows, Linux and macOS. Protocol: store (docs/plugins.md). Config: appId, items {product: item definition id}, dlc {product: DLC app id}, restartIfNecessary, sdk (path to the Steamworks SDK; default $STEAMWORKS_SDK).
sdkHint: Steamworks SDK: download from https://partner.steamgames.com/downloads (unzip; the folder that has public/ and redistributable_bin/), then set STEAMWORKS_SDK=<that folder> or game.json plugins → steam → "sdk".
